simpledinos.guide.page.1.title: Simple Dinosaurs
simpledinos.guide.page.1: Brush a fossil block free for a dinosaur egg, sit on the egg to brood it, and raise a hatchling into a rideable T. rex.
simpledinos.guide.page.2.title: Fossil block
simpledinos.guide.page.2: A very rare find in the underground of deserts, badlands and swamps. Mined with Silk Touch it stays a block; without it, it breaks into up to two bones and the find is lost. Brush it with the Vanilla brush:
simpledinos.guide.page.3.title: Fossil block
simpledinos.guide.page.3: after about a minute of brushing, a dinosaur egg falls out.
simpledinos.guide.page.4.title: Dinosaur eggs
simpledinos.guide.page.4: One egg per dinosaur: T. rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Utahraptor and Parasaurolophus. Place the egg, then sit on it with an empty hand (right click):
simpledinos.guide.page.5.title: Dinosaur eggs
simpledinos.guide.page.5: after 5 minutes of sitting it is brooded, after 10 more minutes it hatches into a hatchling that belongs to the player who sat longest.
simpledinos.guide.page.6.title: T. rex
simpledinos.guide.page.6: The combat mount: life size, a core hitbox of 3 x 4 blocks (head and tail reach beyond it). It hatches as a tame hatchling at a quarter of its size and grows to full size in 40 minutes (setting growMinutes); meat speeds growth up.
simpledinos.guide.page.7.title: T. rex
simpledinos.guide.page.7: Only adults carry a rider, with a large saddle.
simpledinos.guide.page.8.title: Large saddle and T. rex armor
simpledinos.guide.page.8: The large saddle (a saddle, 4 leather and 4 iron ingots) fits only dinosaurs; one rider. The T.
simpledinos.guide.page.9.title: Large saddle and T. rex armor
simpledinos.guide.page.9: rex armor comes in leather, iron and diamond (8 of the material around a bone block) with the protection values of the Vanilla horse armor (3, 5, 11).
simpledinos.guide.page.10.title: Commands
simpledinos.guide.page.10: /simpledinos config shows and changes every option of config/simpledinos-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpledinos.guide.page.11.title: Commands
simpledinos.guide.page.11: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once. Permission level 2.
simpledinos.guide.page.12.title: Settings
simpledinos.guide.page.12: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
